messages:
erin-support: FYI customer ACME (ticket #7891) reporting tool/function-call failures after model rollout v17.2. Seeing a bunch of 422 schema validation errors starting ~08:11 UTC in us-east-1. Attaching logs/snippet below.

erin-support: ```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/v17.2",
  "input": "lookup user by id",
  "tool": "lookup_user "  // note trailing space from client
}
Response: 422 {"error": "tool schema mismatch: unknown tool 'lookup_user '"}
```

alex-eng: looking into it now, thanks. do we have volume by api-key/tenant?

jordan-sre: telemetry shows a spike in toolcall 422s at 08:11:20-08:12:00, concentrated to a handful of tenant API keys (including ACME). Auths remain 200. Latency unaffected.

maya-ml: holding — the v17.2 model change intentionally switched to strict tool/schema matching (json-schema enforcement) to avoid ambiguous tool selection. That would reject a trailing-space tool name and also different key names like `toolName` vs `tool`.

sam-cse: customer payloads are messy — we saw both `tool` and `toolName` in different SDKs, plus some clients add trailing whitespace. v17.1 coerced/normalized these; v17.2 refuses.

alex-eng: shortest mitigation is tenant pin to v17.1 or relax schema server-side. Can we route ACME to legacy variant?

deploy-bot: Canary report: v17.2 reached 100% in us-east-1 at 08:10:05 UTC. Rollback requires manual start.

jordan-sre: I recommend two-step: 1) create tenant-level routing rule for ACME -> v17.1 (fast) 2) apply hotfix to v17.2 runtime to tolerate common aliases/trailing whitespace.

erin-support: I'll ask ACME if tenant-pinning is acceptable while we hotfix. They want an ETA.

alex-eng: hotfix prepared: set FEATURE_STRICT_TOOL_SCHEMA=false in runtime config to enable legacy coercion for tool selector. Patch will not change model weights. Testing in staging now.

maya-ml: note: disabling strict schema reopens potential ambiguous picks; acceptable short-lived tradeoff. We should add a canary test case for aliasing after patch.

deploy-bot: Patching us-east-1 runtime pool now: applied env toggle to prod-pool-3.

jordan-sre: after patch, ACME 422s dropped to baseline within 3 minutes. Still monitoring for regressions.

alex-eng: decision: do not full rollback yet. Use tenant pin + schema toggle as mitigation. Plan full rollback if we see any functional regressions or increased ambiguous tool picks by 09:00 UTC.

erin-support: Customer accepts temporary pin. Moving ticket #7891 -> awaiting verification.

sam-cse: repro steps (shared with customer):
```bash
# failing against v17.2 (strict)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/v17.2","input":"lookup user","tool":"lookup_user "}' \
# => 422 tool schema mismatch

# pinned to v17.1 or after hotfix -> works
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/v17.1","input":"lookup user","tool":"lookup_user "}' \
# => 200 with tool invocation payload
```

alex-eng: I'll add a postmortem checklist: add canary unit test for tool-name aliasing + auto-trim whitespace + update model onboarding doc to include schema-change checklist (notify support and create migration guide).

erin-support: Thanks team. I'll update the customer and close once they verify. Filing follow-up: ACTIONS: tenant-pin ACME, hotfix schema toggle, add canary tests, doc updates.

jordan-sre: adding note: monitor for billing/auth anomalies — none seen so far. If billing errors show up we escalate.

alex-eng: +1. Good catch. Will follow up in postmortem thread. :thumbsup:
